Interface ConfigurableEnvironment

All Superinterfaces:
ConfigurablePropertyResolver, Environment, PropertyResolver
All Known Subinterfaces:
ConfigurableWebEnvironment
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractEnvironment, MockEnvironment, StandardEnvironment, StandardServletEnvironment
public interface ConfigurableEnvironment extends Environment, ConfigurablePropertyResolver
Configuration interface to be implemented by most if not all Environment types. Provides facilities for setting active and default profiles and manipulating underlying property sources. Allows clients to set and validate required properties, customize the conversion service and more through the ConfigurablePropertyResolver superinterface.

操纵属性源

属性源可以被移除、重新排序或替换；并且可以使用从getPropertySources()返回的MutablePropertySources实例添加额外的属性源。以下示例针对ConfigurableEnvironment的StandardEnvironment实现，但通常适用于任何实现，尽管特定的默认属性源可能有所不同。

添加具有最高搜索优先级的新属性源

ConfigurableEnvironment environment = new StandardEnvironment();
MutablePropertySources propertySources = environment.getPropertySources();
Map<String, Object> myMap = new HashMap<>();
myMap.put("xyz", "myValue");
propertySources.addFirst(new MapPropertySource("MY_MAP", myMap));

示例：移除默认系统属性属性源

MutablePropertySources propertySources = environment.getPropertySources();
propertySources.remove(StandardEnvironment.SYSTEM_PROPERTIES_PROPERTY_SOURCE_NAME)

为测试目的模拟系统环境

MutablePropertySources propertySources = environment.getPropertySources();
MockPropertySource mockEnvVars = new MockPropertySource().withProperty("xyz", "myValue");
propertySources.replace(StandardEnvironment.SYSTEM_ENVIRONMENT_PROPERTY_SOURCE_NAME, mockEnvVars);
When an Environment is being used by an ApplicationContext, it is important that any such PropertySource manipulations be performed before the context's refresh() method is called. This ensures that all property sources are available during the container bootstrap process, including use by property placeholder configurers.
Since:
3.1
Author:
Chris Beams

  • Method Details

    • setActiveProfiles

      void setActiveProfiles(String... profiles)
      Specify the set of profiles active for this Environment. Profiles are evaluated during container bootstrap to determine whether bean definitions should be registered with the container.

      任何现有的活动配置文件都将被给定的参数替换；调用时不带任何参数可清除当前的活动配置文件集。使用addActiveProfile(String)在保留现有集合的同时添加一个配置文件。

      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - 如果任何配置文件为 null、空或仅包含空白字符
      See Also:
      • addActiveProfile(String)
      • setDefaultProfiles(String...)
      • Profile
      • AbstractEnvironment.ACTIVE_PROFILES_PROPERTY_NAME

    • getPropertySources

      MutablePropertySources getPropertySources()
      返回此 Environment 的 PropertySources 的可变形式，允许操作在解析属性时应搜索的 PropertySource 对象集。各种 MutablePropertySources 方法，例如 addFirst、addLast、addBefore 和 addAfter，允许对属性源顺序进行细粒度控制。这在确保某些用户定义的属性源具有搜索优先级（高于默认属性源，如系统属性集或系统环境变量集）时非常有用。
      See Also:
      • AbstractEnvironment.customizePropertySources(MutablePropertySources)

    • getSystemProperties

      Map<String,Object> getSystemProperties()
      Return the value of System.getProperties().

      注意，大多数 `Environment` 实现都会将此系统属性映射包含为默认搜索的 PropertySource。因此，除非明确打算绕过其他属性源，否则不建议直接使用此方法。

    • getSystemEnvironment

      Map<String,Object> getSystemEnvironment()
      Return the value of System.getenv().

      请注意，大多数 Environment 实现都会将此系统环境映射包含为默认要搜索的 PropertySource。因此，除非明确打算绕过其他属性源，否则不建议直接使用此方法。

    • merge

      void merge(ConfigurableEnvironment parent)
      Append the given parent environment's active profiles, default profiles, and property sources to this (child) environment's respective collections of each.

      对于在父级和子级中均存在的同名 `PropertySource` 实例，将保留子级实例并丢弃父级实例。这允许子级覆盖属性源，同时避免对公共属性源类型（例如系统环境变量和系统属性）进行冗余搜索。

      活动及默认配置文件名称也会进行重复过滤，以避免混淆和冗余存储。

      父环境在任何情况下都保持不变。请注意，在调用 `merge` 之后对父环境进行的任何更改都不会反映到子环境中。因此，在调用 `merge` 之前，应小心配置父属性源和配置文件信息。

      Parameters:
      parent - 要合并的环境
      Since:
      3.1.2
      See Also:
      • AbstractApplicationContext.setParent(ApplicationContext)
